Wafer #Neg printed '380-3000' and IM-Ratio '7.6-60' with hyphen (other rows use '~'); copied as printed; p.7
n_classes=2 refers to the constructed binary apportions, not the original UCR class counts; p.8
notes: Folder 'Both' but paper is binary only (two-class apportions). 48 imbalanced apportions built from 7 UCR datasets; apportioned data shared at http://sites.google.com/site/sstarcao/ (not fetched). Table 2 (image) gives per-dataset F-Value, G-Mean, Precision, Recall, TNR for Repeat/SMOTE/B-SMOTE/ADASYN/DataBoost/SPO/INOS with SVM. Tables 3 (Adiac) and 4 (Yoga) give per-apportion F-Value/G-Mean incl. SMO(TE); Table 5 integration variants (ESPO+SMO 70%); Table 6 compares INOS vs Easy/Bal./1NN/1NN DTW (no SMOTE). Additional 7 UCR datasets (CBF, Synthetic Control, OSU Leaf, Fish, Gun-Point, Trace, ECG) results only online at https://sites.google.com/site/sstarcao/publication/journal-papers (not fetched). INOS = ESPO (r=0.7) + ADASYN (30%) + noise-link cleaning; SVM RBF with (C,g) grid search. Without oversampling avg F-Value 72.9%, G-Mean 77.7% (p.10).
